notes.content:
-Sticks can be stacked
-Stamina generates faster when standing still
-Fixed bug with full inventory
-Add description to buildings and items
-Update some sprites

-Adjust health gain/loss based on food/warmth
-Increase stone occurrence slightly
-Added simple crafting and building tooltip
-Added HUD indicator when character is about to die

-Fix light issue
-Added map coordinates in top left corner
-Other small improvements

-Now character spawns with Stone Axe
-Improve drops in general
-Now possible to use scroll wheel to change item selection
-Improved the item event text
-Now possible to build on top of crack in ground

-Reduce food and warmth loss per second
-Improve loot from stone pile and treasure chest
-Add more tips in loading screen
Made early progression a little easier.
